segments.comment: windows.c decode_mixed() on text a player typed, under each putmixed() caller that shows it: the dust engraving "a\b" lists as "ab" in pager.c look_engrs() (/ e), and the kitten called "c\d" shows as "cd" in do_look()'s farlook (; m .) and in look_all()'s monster list (/ m). getpos.c auto_describe() prints with custompline(), not putmixed(), so the cursor's autodescribe keeps "c\d".
